record.question: A client with OCD spends many hours each day washing her hands. The most likely reason she washes her hands so much is that it:
options: Gives her a feeling of control over her life
record.explanation: Answer A: Relieves her anxiety. Compulsions such as repeated handwashing are performed to reduce distress/anxiety caused by obsessions or feared consequences. Reference: https://www.nimh.nih.gov/health/topics/obsessive-compulsive-disorder-ocd. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
